title: A chapter before dawn
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: After the microwave background was released and before the first stars formed, there were no stars to illuminate the universe. Radiation still existed, including the background light.

misconception: A learner may choose: A time when all radiation disappeared
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What does the phrase cosmic dark ages refer to?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What does the phrase cosmic dark ages refer to? A period before the first stars illuminated the universe. After the microwave background was released and before the first stars formed, there were no stars to illuminate the universe. Radiation still existed, including the background light.
Visual caption: Before the first stars. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: What does the phrase cosmic dark ages refer to?
options: A time when all radiation disappeared
A present-day region inside Earth's shadow
A period before the first stars illuminated the universe
recall.why: After the microwave background was released and before the first stars formed, there were no stars to illuminate the universe. Radiation still existed, including the background light.
